get_area() → Area | None[source]

Get the area associated to this bus.

The bus-level reference has priority because it is the most specific assignment for this object. If it is not available, the method falls back to the substation hierarchy.

Returns:

Area object or None

get_community() → Community | None[source]

Get the community associated to this bus.

The value is obtained through the substation hierarchy because the bus does not store a direct community reference.

Returns:
